implementation.purpose: Dedicated GitHub App launcher that validates a fresh D7 authorization, target tuple, binding identity, and unexpired window before minting one short-lived installation token in memory.
Extend collection to represent typed GitHub HTTPS GET and frozen local Git-object sources without source substitution.
Persist exactly thirteen evidence/result pairs for either a complete success path or a complete fail-closed blocked path, consuming the run only once.
Fixture-only tests proving authorization validation precedes token minting and secrets are never serialized.
Fixture-only tests for typed sources and CTRL-039 frozen-binding reconstruction.
Fixture-only tests for complete blocked-run persistence and no-retry enforcement.

source_types.GITHUB_HTTPS_GET: One of the exact D5 endpoint templates, with redirects rejected and only HTTP 200 accepted for an available source.
source_types.FROZEN_LOCAL_GIT_OBJECT: A read of the committed Hayes binding contracts/bindings/aa4/aa4_d4_target_ctrl039_binding.json, retaining its path, Git blob identity, and captured object payload.

authorized_if_approved.blocked_run_semantics: For an unavailable or invalid approved source, form an explicit evidence record with collection_status BLOCKED and the D5 fail-closed reason; form the paired result with result_status EXECUTION_BLOCKED. A blocked record is never PASS or FAIL.

launcher_invariants: Validate status ISSUED_ACTIVE_NOT_CONSUMED, exact run target, exact client binding, NOT_CONSUMED state, and current time not later than expiry before signing an App JWT or calling the installation-token endpoint.

Use the App private key only in process memory. Never write key bytes, JWTs, installation tokens, or authorization headers to source, evidence, results, manifests, logs, exceptions, or certification artifacts.
Call POST /app/installations/157004879/access_tokens at most once per authorized run and only after the validations pass.

After token minting, allow HTTPS GET only to the two listed preflight endpoints and the exact D5 GitHub endpoint templates; reject redirects, unexpected methods, endpoint expansion, and non-200 available-source responses.
The launcher performs no write, dispatch, deployment, issue, pull-request, secret, organization, or production operation.
typed_source_invariants: CTRL-039 retains both required sources: the live aa4-controlled-release environment HTTPS GET and the frozen local binding Git-object read.

A source record declares source_kind, request_method, immutable source identity where applicable, response status where applicable, and captured payload; local Git-object reads are never represented as HTTPS requests.
Repository-content requests retain the exact frozen revision in their URI and returned object SHA where supplied.
A live configuration observation is sealed no more than fifteen minutes after collection.
acceptance_tests: Expired, consumed, target-mismatched, binding-mismatched, or otherwise invalid authorization causes zero token minting and zero HTTP requests.
The launcher rejects a redirect, non-GET method, non-whitelisted endpoint, and non-200 available-source response.
A CTRL-039 record reconstructs from one live environment source plus the exact frozen binding Git object.
An unavailable source yields thirteen persisted evidence/result pairs only when all pairs are explicitly blocked or unresolved as required; no pair is PASS or FAIL solely from unavailability.
A second persistence attempt for the same run ID fails before any output mutation.
Fixture tests, lint, and static compilation pass without GitHub network access.
